solutionSql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers AS c WHERE (SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) FROM shipments AS s WHERE s.customer_id = c.id) > (SELECT AVG(o.weight_kg) FROM shipments AS o) ORDER BY c.id;

rules.howSolved: Each customer's AVG weight is compared with the table-wide AVG weight using >.
Both sides use AVG, which returns numeric, so there is no integer division.
AVG skips NULL weights for both the customer average and the table average.

ambiguities: A customer whose shipments all lack a weight, or who has no shipments, has a NULL average and is left out. The ticket does not say this in words; it follows from the comparison.
notes: Read-only item. Ran without error on sample, nulls, ties, boundary and nulltext. Solve time is an estimate.
